confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Restaurant anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation varies by area (Patong, Kata/Karon, Phuket Town) and season; July is low season on the Andaman coast, so room rates are approximate. Cocktail (about 2x beer) and wine_glass (about 2.3x beer) use a beer-relative basis because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX figure comes from search-result reports of the RBA 4pm rate dated 2026-10-15; the RBA page itself was not opened, so verify before downstream use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Estimates reflect general knowledge of Thai resort-island pricing, broadly similar to Krabi and Koh Samui, with accommodation adjusted for the July low season.
